'''Yōko Hikasa''' (Japanese: '''日笠陽子''' ''Hikasa Yōko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hikasa was born on July 16, 1985, in {{wp|Kanagawa Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and she became a singer and actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, where she voiced [[Ellie]]. Since then, Hikasa has voiced several [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] before gaining her most notable role of [[Galar]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Bea]] during {{aniseries|JN}}.
